disposition: Two distinct measured native PS5.1 problems remain. Successful ASCII-path compilation reaches strict cleanup and retains Administrators-owned descendants. Unicode-path compilation fails with CS0016 before staging initialization. No production workaround is demonstrated by this review.

findings.severity: Important qualification gap; observed safe retention, not unsafe deletion

evidence.cleanupError: Compiler output custody could not be proved.

compilerHealthyRows.case: terminal-parent admission mutant with useful healthy caller

reasoning: The root is self-owned, protected, private, and has the same held identity. All five retained CodeDOM files in the saved post-compile readback have owner S-1-5-32-544 (Administrators), unprotected DACL, and one inherited full-control ACE for the actual subject SID.

Clear-StagingCompilerContext line 197 requires Owner equal to Context.Sid AND TrustedParent. StageNative.Read line 387 makes TrustedParent false when owner differs from sid, independently of ACL permissions. The saved owner mismatch therefore suffices to trigger the observed cleanup error.
This occurrence does not establish a foreign-user write or unsafe cleanup. The implementation retains the private root and reports retained-cleanup-failed; it does not delete the unproved files.
The absent protected flag on each inherited child is not by itself the source rejection: the descendant gate uses TrustedParent, not Private. Owner mismatch is the measured decisive discrepancy.
unmeasured: The process primary TokenOwner value and effective thread token owner were not captured in these receipts. Administrators ownership is consistent with the documented default-token-owner mechanism but is not proof of the token value.
Native link count and exact child handle identities are not in the saved ACL rows; preserve actual Inspect checks in any correction.

evidence.selectedCase: native private roots precede artifact writes
evidence.errorLine: error CS0016: Could not write to output file 'c:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\r0015-native-dd794e70524e48e4bd0a65eeff5d0324-ص\private-roots\temp\SalahWidgetCompiler-6a31ac40cb7945ad96816f23a581bb4f\gjp10wp2.dll' -- 'The directory name is invalid. '

reasoning: The selected /out path is exactly 172 UTF-16 code units and includes U+0635. The original response-file bytes preserve that character; this selected failure is not a 260-character output path or a demonstrated receipt-decoding substitution.

The .out file records the same compiler argument path and CS0016 with the reason that the directory name is invalid. The error text alone does not identify which underlying file or temporary-directory operation failed.

The parent PS process created CodeDOM source/response/capture files under the Unicode root. Successful source/response writes do not establish that the compiler child received the same TEMP/TMP environment.

The ASCII first-call control compiles the same StageNative source hash c738e378b35a298d16e201c9e92daa8325e998bf361d1274198dd1beb4da5a7b successfully, then fails the separate cleanup-owner check. Existing ASCII/Unicode suites have different path layouts; they are useful localization evidence but not an isolated one-variable causal experiment.

supportedHypothesis.mechanism: Microsoft .NET Framework CodeDOM Executor builds an explicit environment block with EnvironmentBlock.ToByteArray(environment, false), then CreateProcess flags 0. Microsoft CreateProcessW documentation specifies that a supplied environment block with flags 0 is interpreted as ANSI. Child TEMP/TMP can therefore differ from a correct Unicode parent environment on an incompatible code page, while the UTF-8 response file and Unicode command line remain intact.

smallestDecisiveNativeProbe.owner: Root/reviewer native diagnostic workflow; this reviewer performed no execution.
smallestDecisiveNativeProbe.isolation: Fresh owned NTFS fixture only; retain original f801 source and execute actual functions obtained from its AST. Each cold process has type absent before compilation. Bind source/test hashes, PID/nonce, host binary/version, OS, architecture and terminal drain/exit. Never change real profile/global TEMP, ACLs, code page or tokens.
pairedActualCaller: Equal-length ASCII and U+0635 path variants with identical layout, private descriptor, ancestry policy, input C# bytes and output-file name. Record requested/physical paths, identities, DACLs and lengths before actual Initialize-StagingNative.
Record actual source caller compile result separately from cleanup result; a successful compile plus retained-cleanup-failed is not a Unicode compile failure or a healthy cleanup pass.
Read process primary TokenOwner and effective user/owner (including whether a thread token exists), before and after. Measure child output owner/DACL/link/identity without altering it.
decisiveEnvironmentBoundary: Under each admitted private context, run a bounded no-profile child environment reporter through the actual framework System.CodeDom.Compiler.Executor.ExecWaitWithCapture with a TempFileCollection under that root. Reporter emits only PID/nonce, TEMP/TMP code points and native GetTempPath, current directory and code-page IDs; it must not print the full inherited environment.

Record the parent values and strict code-page roundtrip for U+0635. Compare actual child values rather than inferring them from .cmdline. The reporter is a diagnostic boundary adapter, not installer success evidence.

If the child environment is altered, a same-source compiler counterfactual that changes only transport of TEMP/TMP while keeping both temp roots explicitly private and admitted can test causality. Root must review its boundary; no shared/unsafe fallback is implied.
smallestDecisiveNativeProbe.conditionalSecondProbe: Only if environment transport does not discriminate, compare direct csc with exact source/UTF-8 response bytes, explicit Unicode environment, owned current directory and absolute versus relative output under the same owned root. This diagnoses compiler path handling; it is not an automatic production design.
passCriteria: ASCII and Unicode failures are attributed to actual compiler outcome and cleanup state separately.
Unsafe-parent and foreign-ancestor zero-compiler-output refusals remain useful controls.
All output is within the verified owned compiler roots; both TEMP/TMP are restored; failed or unproved roots are retained truthfully.
No control count, planning receipt or supplemental host result is promoted to native/whole-contract acceptance.

primarySources.supports: Default object owner is the token owner SID, which can be a user or group SID already in the token.
Token user, owner and default DACL are distinct; effective thread and process primary tokens can differ.

UTF-8 compiler output/response file; /out argument; default output precreation and failure deletion; compiler delegates environment/current-directory launch to Executor. Reference implementation, not installed binary attestation.
Launch temporarily reverts impersonation; environment serialized with false Unicode flag; CreateProcess receives explicit block and flags 0.
Explicit environment with flags 0 is ANSI; Unicode environment requires CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT.
